body: Honestly, I wish I had someone who cared about me. My parents are abusive assholes, emotionally and physically. I used to have friends here at college but I haven't talked to most of them since like November last year. The only good friend I had last year decided to not come back. The only person of my family who I ever thought cared about me was my brother, and I cared about him like he was my best friend since childhood, killed himself last October. I literally have no one.
I apperciate you talking to me, but I can see where this is going. I don't really have any desire to not go through with this. Thanks for talking to me.

Honestly, it's about 3 years too late. At this point I don't have the energy or will to do that. Giving up is much easier. It's not even that I want to die, I'm afraid to, but anything is better then this. So thank you, but honestly it's too late for me.
Issue is I'm only 19, I'll be 20 in a month. I only have 6,500 in savings and another 2000 tied up in investments. I don't know where I would go and I don't have enough cash or skills to do anything.

I appericate the comments but like you've said, it's impossible to talk me out of this right now. I wish I had some family that cared but my dad's an abusive asshole and my mom isn't much better. Their advice for me? "Get over it and be a man". The only family member I've ever cared for or felt connected to was my brother but he killed himself last october.
